title: HouseRegistry
description: PUT /registry of the Jetson learner (D38): what the learner needs to read the journal like the add-on does — areas, the entities with their current state, our own automations and the tier policy. Sent on start and whenever HA's registries change.

time_zone.description: HA's time zone (IANA), so hours and weekdays mean the house's

attributes.description: a small subset: friendly_name, device_class, unit_of_measurement

registry.description: a subset of the entity registry entry: disabled_by, hidden_by, entity_category, platform

ours.description: automation entity → {ha_id, ask, targets: [[entity_id, state]]} for our deployed automations (core/insights.py `mine`)

policy.description: the add-on's tier policy (schemas/policy.schema.json): T3 devices are never proposed

settings.description: habit_days / habit_min_repeats the add-on uses, so both read the same way
